# Hotel Description  
  
## Hotel General Description:  
The hotel is located in Belgium.  
	 - The hotel has a three-star rating.  
	 - It is a medium-sized hotel with 51 rooms.  
	 - The hotel can be categorized as a city city.  
  
## Hotel Extended Description:  
  
	-Property Name:  
	Hotel chamade  
  
	-General description :  
	A charming boutique establishment located just 2 minutes from Ghent-Sint-Pieters Station, offering a warm and personal atmosphere. With a commitment to sustainable hospitality, guests can enjoy fresh, locally sourced breakfasts and genuine service while being within walking distance of historic Ghent.  
  
	-Hotel features :  
	Its commitment to sustainability, being a certified green key hotel that prioritizes local and fair-trade products in its services.

	-Family amenities information :

## Hotel Extended Description:  
  
	-Description :  
	Well set in the Stationsbuurt Noord district of Ghent, Hotel Chamade is located a 3-minute walk from Gent-Sint-Pieters Train Station, half a mile from Millions Quarter and an 11-minute walk from Bijloke Ghent. Featuring a bar, the 3-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, each with a private bathroom. Graslei and Korenlei Ghent is 1.9 miles from the hotel and Design Museum Ghent is 1.9 miles away.  
  
At the hotel, each room has a desk. Every room has an electric tea pot, while certain rooms here will provide you with a terrace and others also provide guests with city views. All guest rooms in Hotel Chamade are equipped with a TV and free toiletries.  
  
Breakfast is available, and includes buffet, continental and vegetarian options.  
  
Popular points of interest near the accommodation include STAM Ghent City Museum, Muinkpark and The World of Kina. Antwerp International Airport is 39 miles away.

Does hotel chamade follow sustainability practices? Yes, hotel chamade has the following sustainability policies in place: Hotel Chamade is committed to sustainability through various practices. It holds a green key certification, reflecting its dedication to sustainable hospitality. The hotel collaborates with local suppliers to source products from Ghent farmers, reducing delivery distances and supporting the local economy. It uses fair-trade products and cradle-to-cradle items in its bathrooms, ensuring complete recyclability. In 2024, the hotel underwent a full renovation, installing a new, energy-efficient HVAC system, switching all lighting to LED, and adding extra building insulation. The hotel purchases 100% renewable electricity and operates an electric delivery van charged exclusively with green electricity. Water conservation measures include installing aerator taps in 15 bathrooms. Waste is sorted into five streams in partnership with Renewi. Additionally, the hotel supports reforestation projects by planting trees in Peru and Madagascar through Go Forest.. [Related terms: eco-friendly, green hotel, environmental policy, recycling, carbon footprint]

Can you describe the rooms at hotel chamade? Comfort Double Room: The double room features air conditioning, a tea and coffee maker, as well as a private bathroom boasting a bath or a shower and a hairdryer. The unit has 1 bed.  
Comfort Twin Room: The twin room offers air conditioning, a tea and coffee maker, as well as a private bathroom boasting a bath or a shower and a hairdryer. The unit has 2 beds.  
Comfort Single Room: The single room provides air conditioning, a tea and coffee maker, as well as a private bathroom featuring a shower and a hairdryer. The single room offers a TV, a wardrobe, a carpeted floor and heating. The unit offers 1 bed.  
Comfort Triple Room: The triple room provides air conditioning, a tea and coffee maker, as well as a private bathroom featuring a bath and a hairdryer. The unit offers 3 beds.  
Deluxe Double Room with Bath: Providing free toiletries, this double room includes a private bathroom with a walk-in shower, a bath and a hairdryer. The spacious air-conditioned double room provides a TV with streaming services, a mini-bar, a tea and coffee maker, a wardrobe as well as city views. The unit offers 1 bed.  
Deluxe Double Room with Balcony: This air-conditioned double room is consisted of of a TV with streaming services, a private bathroom as well as a terrace with city views. The unit has 1 bed.. [Related terms: room details, accommodation types, suite features, room layout]
